name: DeepSeek V4 Flash
thinking_terminator_hint:
Considering the limited time by the user, I have to give the solution based on the thinking directly now.
</think>
notes: hard_limit_reply_budget was raised from 512 to 1024 and thinking_terminator_hint added after evaluation showed that a bare </think> force-close could end with no visible answer. The directive plus terminator reliably induces a visible response. reasoning_effort_tiers.low was reduced from 4096 to 768 because the model commonly consumes the full allowance; callers can raise reasoning_effort for tasks that benefit. Temperature 0.6 and top_p 0.95 follow the model recommendation and avoid the repetition/coherence cost observed with greedy target decoding when speculation is unavailable.
